question: In a certain code language, 'PINT' is coded as '60', and 'HOME' is coded as '42'. How will 'TONE' be coded in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfd58ae8c21703117c748271580b137fe46307a963bbe4e833ab7dfcdc88ddc9.png] Logic: **Sum of the place value + 1**.

Now,

'PINT' is coded as '60',

⇒ P(16) + I(9) + N(14) + T(20) + 1

⇒ 16 + 9 + 14 + 20 + 1 = 60.</s
